title: Automatic Sorting - Impact Tresor
description: Sorts the plugins and checks the version for Vault to make sure everything is correct.
body:
# 🔧 Impactor Vault Bridge – Automatic Sorting

No more headaches. Just install and get started.

## ⚙️ How it works

Automatically manages the correct loading order of your Economy plugins and checks the required Vault version for the Impactor Vault Bridge – fully automatic, no configuration required.

## ✅ Features

- Automatically detects and checks your Vault version
- Ensures the correct loading order of plugins for Impactor Economy + Vault
- No configuration required
- Lightweight and non-invasive
- Designed for Arclight servers

## 📋 Requirements

- Arclight Server
- Impactor Vault Bridge
- Vault
- Impactor Economy

## 💡 Why?

Incorrect loading order and incompatible Vault versions are the main causes of errors in Economy plugins. This plugin fixes that automatically.
